update.move.message: Move RenanDesign to your Applications folder?
update.move.detail: RenanDesign is running from the disk image or Downloads, where it can't update itself. Your projects and settings come with it.
update.prompt.title: A new version of RenanDesign is ready
update.prompt.empty: This version only has behind-the-scenes changes.
update.prompt.restartNote: RenanDesign restarts when the download finishes.
update.progress.downloadingDetail: You can keep working. RenanDesign restarts when the download finishes.
update.progress.installingDetail: RenanDesign is closing to install version {version}. It reopens on its own in a few seconds.
update.progress.failedDetail: RenanDesign will offer this version again later. Your work is safe.
